item.title: TSMC Share Climbs to 75% as Pure-Play Foundry Market Grows 36%
item.description:
Counterpoint data shows the global pure-play foundry market grew 36% year over year and 13% quarter over quarter in Q3 2026, driven by AI demand for advanced nodes and packaging outpacing supply. TSMC's share rose to 75% from 73% in the prior two quarters on 16% sequential revenue growth, backed by 2nm ramp, fully loaded N3 capacity and CoWoS expansion, while Samsung slipped to 6.4% and SMIC held third on record revenue.

原文标题：台积电 Q3 份额升至 75% 纯代工市场同比增长 36%

Why it matters：这是 AI 算力供给格局的关键量化信号，直接反映先进制程与 CoWoS 封装的供需紧张程度。

item.title: Theoretical Physicists Move to Build a Fair AI Benchmark
item.description:
Theoretical physicist Suvrat Raju tested a frontier AI model with an unpublished physics problem; the model failed but performed better than expected, prompting him and a colleague to build a dedicated theoretical physics benchmark. The effort stresses original, never-published problems to avoid memorization contamination from internet training data.

原文标题：理论物理学家着手构建 AI 基准测试

Why it matters：提出以未公开原创问题评测 AI 物理推理能力的思路，切中大模型基准污染这一关键痛点。

item.title: PrismML Compresses 54 GB Model Down to 5.9 GB
item.description:
PrismML released Ternary Bonsai 2.5 27B, built on Qwen3.8-27B and using ternary quantization where each weight is limited to -1, 0, or +1, cutting memory from roughly 54 GB to 5.9 GB. The update targets long-chain tool-calling agent tasks, lifting SWE-bench Verified from 60.8% to 75.6% and AppWorld from 51.2% to 90.5%, approaching the full-precision base model.

原文标题：PrismML 将 54 GB 模型压缩至 5.9 GB

Why it matters：极端量化把 27B 模型压到手机可承载的体积且智能体能力大幅回升，是端侧部署的重要信号。

item.title: Windows Loudness Equalization Reverse-Engineered and Ported to PipeWire
item.description:
A developer reverse-engineered Windows' Loudness Equalization and the audio engine's output limiter from WMALFXGFXDSP.dll and AudioEng.dll, reimplementing them as PipeWire DSP modules and plugins that even out per-application playback volume. The project ships an optional GTK3 control window for global or per-app toggling and release-time tuning, and requires PipeWire 1.4 or newer.

原文标题：Windows 响度均衡被逆向移植至 PipeWire

Why it matters：把 Windows 独有音频处理链路逆向为 Linux 开源实现，对桌面音频与 PipeWire 生态有实际可用价值。

item.title: MIT Team Finds Synthetic Data Makes AI Climate Models More Reliable
item.description:
A team from MIT, ETH Zurich, and Imperial College London has built an algorithm that trains AI climate emulators on synthetic rather than realistic scenario data, cutting the required training data to a fraction of previous levels. The approach makes emulators faster and cheaper to build and more robust on unfamiliar scenarios, addressing the problem of models being outdated by the time training finishes.

原文标题：MIT 团队发现合成数据可让 AI 气候预测更可靠

Why it matters：用合成数据降低气候模拟器训练成本并提升泛化，是 AI for Science 领域有方法增量的实证结果。

item.title: JD Logistics Launches F2B2C Cold-Chain Solution Covering 340 Cities
item.description:
JD Logistics unveiled the industry's first F2B2C full-scenario cold-chain solution, linking origin, merchant and consumer across more than 340 cities, with over 80% of orders delivered same-day or next-day. Its new Chengdu 'Zhilang' cold-chain warehouse, the industry's first automated low-temperature facility, keeps robots operating at -20°C and lifts picking-to-dispatch efficiency by over 3x.

原文标题：京东物流发布 F2B2C 冷链方案 覆盖 340 城

Why it matters：冷链自动化仓储的低温机器人落地具备真实工程参数与规模数据，是物流 AI 硬件的可参考案例。

item.title: Nvidia Open-Sources 30B Nemotron Image Generation Model
item.description:
Nvidia quietly released the weights of Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B on Hugging Face, a mixture-of-experts autoregressive image model with 30B total and 3B active parameters that is friendlier to local hardware. It serves as the core raster rendering engine of the Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation framework, built around a Pixel-as-Code philosophy that produces editable visual outputs such as web pages, slides and charts. It beats GPT Image 2 on LongTextBench and GenEval but trails on GenEval2 and Qwen-Image-Bench.

原文标题：英伟达开源 300 亿参数生图模型 Nemotron

Why it matters：英伟达开源高参数效率的生图模型权重，并给出可编辑视觉生成的新框架，对本地部署与多模态研究有直接价值。

item.title: Claude-Assisted Lean Proof of Riemann Hypothesis Announced
item.description:
On November 20, 2026, Levent Alpöge announced a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and GRH for Dirichlet L-functions developed with Claude and released solely as a Lean archive. An independent reading project reports that two separate kernels accepted the full proof and that five endpoint theorems match the canonical Mathlib challenge, though the result rests on external replay reports and the semantic fidelity of the formal statements still requires community review.

原文标题：Claude 辅助完成黎曼猜想形式化证明

Why it matters：AI 协作产出重大数学形式化证明，是检验大模型在硬核推理与定理证明能力上的关键节点。

item.description:

AWS CFO John Felton said the risk of moving too slowly in AI outweighs the risk of heavy spending, with land, power and permits locked in early while servers are ordered later once customer demand is clearer.

item.title: Kingsoft Posts 204 Million Yuan Net Loss in Q3 Fiscal 2026
item.description:

Underlying operations stayed solid: adjusted net profit rose 12% to 301 million yuan, office software revenue grew 16% to 1.766 billion yuan, and associate Kingsoft Cloud's AI cloud billing revenue surged 115%.

Anthropic's system card admits it deliberately capped Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 on AI R&D tasks such as GPU kernel optimization.

item.title: Google G-MTP Drafting Head Speeds Up Gemma 4 Inference 3.14x
item.description:
Google introduces G-MTP, a shared 4-layer drafting head that reads the main model's final activations and existing KV cache to skip prefill, accelerating speculative decoding of Gemma 4 31B by up to 3.14x on H100s versus 2.60x for DFlash and 2.07x for EAGLE-3. By eliminating a separate draft model, it cuts memory overhead and opens a path to on-device deployment. The paper also notes that fine-tuning only the main model degrades drafter block efficiency by 36.3% on SciQA, requiring distillation of the drafter on the new model to recover it.

原文标题：谷歌 G-MTP 让 Gemma 4 推理提速 3.14 倍

Why it matters：提出免独立草稿模型的投机解码新范式，实测提速数据明确且给出微调后的工程注意事项。

item.description:

Once disabled, future chats are excluded from training data, with the exception of feedback users actively submit.

item.description:
